How this board is scored

    Rules every board shares

    Fourteen-day seasons

    A season starts every other Monday at 00:00 UTC and ends fourteen days later. Standings reset; nothing carries over except your account, your XP and your history.

    Paid automatically, in USD

    The top five on each board are credited to their MarginPad rewards balance right after the season ends. No form, no claim. The balance is withdrawable under the rewards rules.

    Server-side fills only

    Every paper trade is filled on the server against real exchange candles. A trade reported by a browser never counts, and a liquidation is settled on the candle that crosses it, wick or no wick.

    What counts as a win

    A closed trade is a win only with at least 5% ROE and a real 0.2% move in price. Scratches, dust and closes within the spread do not pad a record.

    Members, one account each

    Boards are for signed-in accounts. A second account on the same device or wallet is excluded, and duplicated trade journals (clones) are folded into one entry.

    Public standings, measured numbers

    Every figure here is read from the same tables that pay the prizes. If a number is below its confidence threshold it is not shown, rather than shown wrong.

    Your trades already count

    Sign in, close ten trades this season, and you are on the paper boards. Everything else - the season pass, goals, the daily call - lives on your season page.
